_comment: Single source of truth for this repo's pinned klt / KLayout build. Every machine-read copy (ci.yml, layout/run_flow.sh, the frozen signoff report build block, the DRC/LVS/ERC report provenance) must agree; scripts/check_klt_pin.py enforces it in CI. A release pin (klt_version without a +g<sha> suffix) installs from PyPI as klayout-tools==<klt_version>; klt_commit is then the release tag's commit, kept for provenance. Move the pin, the copies, and the frozen reports in one change. See manifests/README.md.
